
```{python}
import seaborn as sns
df = sns.load_dataset('titanic')
df.head()
```

```{python}

df_class_survival = df[['survived', 'pclass']].groupby('pclass').mean()

df_class_survival.head()

```

```{python}

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.bar(df_class_survival['pclass'], df_class_survival['survived'])

```
